name: io.github.kadaluarsa/werka-interview-preparation
title: Werka Interview Preparation
description: Find interview guides and set up spoken rehearsal for software engineering behavioral interviews.

tools.name: list_interview_programmes
tools.description: Lists Werka’s published interview preparation guides for scholarship panels, admissions, medical residency interviews, and startup accelerators. Returns programme names, IDs, categories, and public guide URLs.

tools.name: get_interview_preparation
tools.description: Returns the public interview preparation guide, programme summary, and Werka video practice setup URL for a supported programme ID.

programmeId.description: ID of a programme in the Werka catalogue.

tools.name: get_job_interview_preparation
tools.description: Returns a public software engineer behavioral interview guide, worked answer, and a Werka video rehearsal link. Use for behavioral interview preparation for software engineering roles.
